inputs.prompt: ONE original tall slim robed conjurer, the Lattice Conjurer veteran, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the layered ivory, navy and gold robes with long hanging panels, the face completely hidden in darkness inside a tall pointed prismatic blue-violet mitre helmet with a delicate gold geometric frame and small hanging diamond crystals, gold gauntlets over black gloves and pointed dark navy boots. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. Both hands hold ONE long dark staff diagonally across the body, a small diamond pommel at the lower screen-left end and a large open gold geometric cage around a blue-violet crystal at the upper screen-right end with hanging diamond pendants. Preserve the full staff, the mitre helmet, the hidden face and the slim adult proportions. Make ONE staff strike toward screen right. The conjurer raises the staff high and back as the knees bend, then lunges forward and drives the caged crystal head out level to full reach at screen right, draws it back and returns to the original diagonal stance. One strike only; no flash or effect at contact. Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep both ends of the staff, the mitre, the robes, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated GREEN throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The green background stays the same flat saturated green in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, additional weapons, beams, projectiles, sparks, motion trails, particles or extra limbs; the crystals keep only their steady glow, and only the caged crystal may brighten where the action says so. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; do not morph the staff.
